labels.label: bzdef:c3s2d5_somme_sphere

hypotheses.note: IsConvexPart w used for « En particulier »; the noyau is not needed

hypotheses.paper: v1, v2, w convexes non vides

findings: l.557: the convention « w est somme de w et du convexe vide » is not a case of the general form of l.548–551 (Déf. 1's sum with an empty summand is empty, so it holds only for w = ∅: eq_empty_of_estSommeS_vide); it is an extension, formalized as a disjunct of EstSomme2.
questions: « w est somme de w et du convexe vide » read symmetrically (either order of the summands).

labels.label: bzdef:c3s2d6_distingue_projectif

hypotheses.note: ¬ ContientDroite (F w) for the claim « La donnée de l détermine complètement l′ » (conjugue_unique), needed: not_conjugue_unique

findings: l.565–566, « La donnée du sous-espace distingué l détermine complètement le sous-espace distingué l′ », is FALSE as printed: relative to the open quarter {y > 0, z > 0} of S(2) (convex, open, support S(2), noyau ∅) the great circle z = 0 is distinguished with two different conjugates {±e3} and {±(e1+e3)} (BooleProjectifInstance.not_conjugue_unique). F(w) contains the line (t, 1, 1), which noyau ∅ does not exclude. With F(w) containing no line the claim is proved for every real E (Benzecri.Sphere.conjugue_unique).
questions: « sous-espace l » read as a linear subvariety s(L − O), indexed by L (linearSubvariety_injective).
« w soit somme de deux convexes v et v′ » read as Déf. 5's two-summand form WITH its convention; under the general form alone ∅ and S(E) (Théorème 3's (0) and (1)) would not be distinguished.

labels.label: bzthm:c3s2t3_algebre_boole_projective

hypotheses.paper: w convexe de S(E), support S(E), noyau vide

hypotheses.note: E finite-dimensional normed, for the topology of « ouvert »
w open (IsOpen w) and ¬ ContientDroite (F w) added; line-freeness alone is insufficient (not_theoreme3, w2 not open); a refutation for open w is not formalized

findings: l.570–576, Théorème 3, is FALSE as printed, even when F(w) contains no line: relative to w2 = s({x ≥ 0, y > 0, z > 0}) ⊂ S(2) (convex, support S(2), noyau ∅, F(w2) line-free, NOT open) the great circles z = 0 (conjugate {±e3}) and y = 0 (conjugate {±e2}) are distinguished and their intersection {±e1} is not (BooleProjectifInstance.not_theoreme3). A refutation of Th. 3 for an open w is not formalized (the open quarter refutes Déf. 6's uniqueness claim and the Corollary only).

The corrected statement, for w open and F(w) line-free in finite dimension, is proved in full: Boolean algebra, (1) = S(E), (0) = ∅, complement THE conjugate (exists, unique), inf the intersection, sup the convex hull (Benzecri.Sphere.theoreme3). Props. 4–5 and their Corollary (l.598–620), which use Th. 3, are stated for open w.

The printed proof (l.594–596, « se reporter aux énoncés correspondants formulés dans le cas affin ») is formalized as the transfer to the affine Théorème 2 on the CLOSED cone K̄ = closure(insert O F(w)) (estConjugueS_iff_affine); it does not go through insert O F(w), whose affine-distinguished subspaces differ (simplexO_kPrime_not_estDistingue) and which may contain lines when the noyau is empty.
questions: « comme sup l'enveloppe convexe » read as the least convex part of S(E) (Chapter 1's convex parts, linear subvarieties included) containing l ∪ d: it is s(L + D − O) (isLeast_linearSubvariety_sup).

Which corrected statement is of record: the one proved (w open, F(w) line-free, E finite-dimensional; the finite dimension only for the topology of « open »), or another, e.g. w closed (Benzécri's « corps convexes »), neither proved nor refuted here?

labels.label: bzcor:c3s2t3c_algebre_parties_projective

hypotheses.note: w open, ¬ ContientDroite (F w), as for theoreme3

findings: l.579–590, the Corollary, is FALSE as printed: relative to the open quarter {y > 0, z > 0} of S(2) (dimension n + 1 = 3, convex, open, support S(2), noyau ∅) the pairs {±(t e1 + e2)}, t ∈ ℝ, are all distinguished, so the distinguished subvarieties are not the parts of any finite set (BooleProjectifInstance.not_corollaire_algebre_parties). Under the hypotheses of theoreme3 it is proved in full, cardinal between 1 and n + 1 included (corollaire_algebre_parties_projective); OQ-165 (b)'s n = 0 failure does not recur since dim E = n + 1 ≥ 1.
questions: « famille » read as a set of simple subvarieties (no repetition), as in the affine Corollary; « obtenue comme enveloppe convexe » read as: s(L − O) is the least convex part containing the members (IsLeast).

instances: BooleProjectifInstance.simplexO_hyps: the open n-simplex of S(n) satisfies every hypothesis of theoreme3 (convex, open, support S(n), noyau ∅, F line-free), with exactly n + 1 simple distinguished subvarieties, the axes (simplexO_simplesS_ncard)
BooleProjectifInstance.capS_simplesS: the open round cap {v2 > 0, v0² + v1² < v2²} of S(2) satisfies the hypotheses, its distinguished subvarieties are ∅ and S(2), one simple (cardinal 1)
BooleProjectifInstance.quartS (open quarter of S(2)) and w2 (half-open quarter): the counterexamples, each satisfying the printed hypotheses
kb_proposals: Chapter3/BooleProjectif: Déf. 6 / Th. 3 on S(E) transfer to the affine Th. 2 on the CLOSED cone closure(kPrime w) for w open (estConjugueS_iff_affine), not on kPrime w (simplexO_kPrime_not_estDistingue); noyau w = ∅ does not exclude lines in F(w) (open quarter).

Chapter3/BooleProjectif: a two-summand sum of Déf. 5 is ConeDec on F(w) (estConjugueS_iff): F(w) = A + A′, A, A′ convex cones without O spanning L, L′, L ⊓ L′ = ⊥; use coneDec_mk with two kernel subspaces for concrete examples in Fin 3 → ℝ.

To show A + A′ ⊆ an open convex C from closure facts, use the open map (c, c′) ↦ P_L c + P_L′ c′ (LinearMap.isOpenMap_of_finiteDimensional) and Convex.interior_closure_eq_interior_of_nonempty_interior.
Transport of an OrderIso along equal sets/predicates: state a lemma with the sets and predicates as variables and subst (exists_orderIso_transport).
notes: Single file (the topological part was merged into BooleProjectif.lean rather than a second module, to typecheck without building an intermediate olean). Builds with 0 sorry, no warning; lake build of the module did not rebuild Benzecri.*. Déf. 5 is marked; Déf. 6, Th. 3 and the Corollary are partial: each is refuted as printed by a Lean counterexample (not_conjugue_unique, not_theoreme3, not_corollaire_algebre_parties) and proved under the added hypotheses (conjugue_unique: F(w) line-free; theoreme3 and corollaire_algebre_parties_projective: w open and F(w) line-free, E finite-dimensional). The planner's evidence that the transfer is through insert 0 (F w), « convex with no line iff noyau w = ∅ », is incorrect (open half-circle / open quarter; simplexO_kPrime_not_estDistingue). Audit round 1 fixes: SCOPE/REPORT no longer claim the open quarter refutes Th. 3 nor that openness is proved necessary; checklist uses « ⚠ strengthened »; closed w added as an alternative statement of record.
